summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan to transform the app into a true, production-grade mobile web browser. Covers:
1. Native & responsive mobile web rendering (removing artificial themes like custom Bilibili cards, loading pure original mobile websites with real User-Agent and desktop/mobile toggle).
2. Dynamic auto-hiding top omnibox and bottom navigation bars on scroll-down with instant slide-in on scroll-up.
3. Full real multi-tab manager with live previews, new tab creation, and closing.
4. Omnibox real-time search suggestions with multi-engine switching (Baidu, Bing, Google, DuckDuckGo).
5. Comprehensive bookmarks and history management with real folder hierarchy, edit/delete, JSON/HTML import and export.
6. Elimination of all prototype mock/dummy artifacts in favor of real, working browser features.
